format.encoding: Strict UTF-8, one optional initial BOM; LF or CRLF. Reject bare CR/NUL/backslash continuation. Allowed only comments,v,vn,vt,f,o,g,s,usemtl,mtllib.
format.vertices: v exactly XYZ or XYZRGB; referenced RGB complete or absent, finite0..1. vt exactly UV, vn exactly XYZ. No homogeneous-W forms.
format.faces: Consistent UV/normal presence per polygon; positive/negative nonzero indices resolved against declarations available at face. At least3 corners. Pin fan(0,i,i+1), no ear-clipping/welding. Bounds cover emitted face vertices.
format.normals: Authored normals retained. Missing normals derive from original parsed Number coordinates before final Float32 storage, matching180.
format.smoothing: s off/0/on/1 only; retain pinned180 run finalization and flatShading behavior.
format.externalMaterials: Never fetch or infer MTL/textures. mtllib retained as unavailable dependency; usemtl retains run identity only. Contextual explanation before fresh creation/conversion if present. No OBJ+MTL bundle support.
format.material: Preserve MeshPhongMaterial white/specular#111111/shininess30 and source vertexColors/smoothing, opaque/lit/front. Never silently Standard-normalize. Native appearance subset remains opacity1/chroma-disabled with exact proof.
format.sourceCatalog: Both o/g start objects under pinned180 rules. Empty initial placeholder, empty/consecutive declarations and objects with no emitted faces consume no ordinal. Number nonempty emitted source objects from0 in source order. Finalize/remove zero-length/trailing inherited runs before numbering retained materialRunOrdinal from0 per object. Global slotIndex ascending source object ordinal then materialArraySlot; representationMaterial(slotIndex). Names never key slots. A nonempty implicit initial object is objectOrdinal0; first o/g may adopt it under180 rules without splitting/reordering earlier faces.
format.sourceProof: Bijection source objectOrdinal/materialRunOrdinal -> actual180 childPath/materialArraySlot ->186 neutral slot facts. No glTF nodeIndex/primitiveIndex fiction in private witness/ID keys.

effects.refuse: smoothBlend,ditherCoverage,transmission,unknown keys and unsupported combinations refuse in command and render preparation. No smooth transparency, new specular/shininess editor or Native alpha conversion.

format.color: Complete referenced source RGB0..1 uses pinned180 sRGB-to-linear then Float32 before per-corner expansion. No linear reinterpretation or Uint8 quantization.
